title: Oxford Spires — Keble College, sequence 02
description: Sequence 2024-03-12-keble-college-02 of the Oxford Spires dataset (Hesai QT64 lidar at 10 Hz and Alphasense IMU on a handheld rig, 300 s, 294 m outdoors). Trajectories are evaluated against the official ground truth (gt-tum.txt, ICP-registered to a Leica TLS map, in the lidar frame); maps against that TLS map.
